title: twin metal headboard
text: twin metal headboard. Mom wanted a new headboard for her guest room twin bed... I chose this one and she loves it.  It works well with other decor.  My brother in law put it together and attached to frame.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Hillsdale Furniture Hillsdale Cole Without Bed Freame Full/Queen Headboard,
features: Elegant transitional metal full/queen headboard with a classic double arch design and sweeping metal scrollwork; Headboard Only
The Black Twinkle finish adds a soft accent to a simple frame
Includes headboard only; Frame, box spring and mattress required, not included
Forged from heavy gauge tubular steel with foundry-poured aluminum castings
The touch of a clean, dry cloth is the only care your furniture will ever need
Recommended Weight Limit: 350 lbs. including mattress
description: Get swept off to dreamland with the Hillsdale Furniture Cole Full / Queen Headboard. The classic double arch design is enhanced by sweeping metal scrollwork. Detailed foundry-poured castings and round finials with a refreshing Black Twinkle finish breathe new life into this transitional metal full / queen headboard. Take your bedroom style up a notch with this perfect piece to create a French-inspired look in your bedroom, this headboard gives off an ethereal allure with its smooth curves and gracefully interlocking pattern. Includes headboard only. Metal bed frame, box spring and mattress not included but required. Assembly required.
